E-Commerce  ( Redesign )

This Is A Design UI Remake Of An E-Commerce Headphone Website. The Challenge Was To Improve The Shopping Experience Through Clean Aesthetics, Bold Typography, And Contemporary Structure Designs — All The While Keeping Product Showcasing And Usability At The Forefront.

"Good design isn’t just what it looks like — it’s how it connects, communicates, and converts."




Goal

To Practice UI Layout Techniques By Redesigning A Product-Focused Landing Page That Is Visually Appealing, Easy To Navigate, And Highlights Features Effectively.

Tools

Time Taken

Approximately 1.5 Days — Including Layout Structuring, Visual Design, And Refining UI Elements.

What I Learned

Through The Redesign, I Refined My Sense Of UI Design, Learned To Keep Brand Aesthetics In Mind, And Explored In Clean Composition Of Layouts With An Emphasis On User Engagement And Simplicity. With This Redesign, I Refined My Sense Of UI Design, Learned Brand Aesthetics Maintenance, And Experimented With Clean Composition Layouts While Prioritizing User Interaction And Simplicity.
